disposition: caller asked for an assault report; two people left in a gold sedan
summary: A caller asked officers to take an assault report on Washington Avenue, and the two people involved had left in a gold sedan before units arrived.
Engine 41 was sent to a hazard on Los Robles Drive where a power pole was reported damaged.

disposition: stopped on its own; occupants compliant, one detained
summary: A traffic stop on Fairfax Road turned into a pursuit that ran south on Madison Street and then through southeast Bakersfield on Watts, Lotus and Cottonwood before the driver pulled over westbound at Shellmacher Avenue. Three people were in the car and all were compliant.
A man was found unconscious behind the wheel of a parked SUV at a gas station on Belvedere Avenue and an ambulance was called.
An ambulance was called to Jackson Park for a person with traumatic injuries.
Engine 3 put out a trash can fire near the stadium at Beach Park on Palm Street.

A vehicle hit a power pole on the north side of Hageman Road and sheared it, leaving lines down across the roadway. A power outage ran along Haley Street from Columbus Street and the utility put its repair about 30 minutes out.
Crews were sent to a possible overdose on Dorrance Street and an engine was started that way with medics.
A bicyclist was reported down in the roadway on Oildale Drive north of El Cajon and a Metro fire crew was sent.
A caller reported someone trying to get into a business through the rear door on Barlow Street.
Drivers reported a white laser being aimed at traffic on southbound Highway 99 and units were advised.
Officers were sent to a disturbance on Tulip Street where a man was reported under the influence and throwing things.
An assault was reported in the alley behind a business on Jackson Street and the suspect was gone when officers arrived.
Deputies were sent to the 2nd and 3rd street area for juveniles who were reported to possibly have a weapon.
Crews were sent to a parking lot on Spectrum Parkway for a possible fentanyl overdose and the patient was taken by ambulance.
Two callers reported hearing two shots in the area of Ming Avenue and Barrington Street and officers were sent to check.
Officers checked a report of someone in a backyard on Pico Avenue.
Officers were sent to a welfare check on Oregon Street for a person reported to be screaming inside a home and making threats.
Four to eight shots were reported heard in the area of River Boulevard and Panorama Drive and officers were sent to look.
Deputies were sent to an assault with a deadly weapon on Harrington Street where a man was reported swinging a metal pole at a woman. Nobody was hurt.
Crews were sent to a medical aid on Arkansas Avenue for a man who was combative with responders; the call was cleared a short time later.
A gas odor call on Jasmine Park Drive was traced to a faulty stove knob and the response was cancelled.
Traffic signals went dark at Brundage Lane and Chester Avenue and a city crew was asked to respond.

A water main broke in the roadway and a bus was caught in it. The water company was called and the road had to be shut down, and a possible sinkhole was being checked with the water district a short time later.

disposition: vehicle entered as stolen; two suspects
summary: A white Chevrolet Tahoe was reported taken from a convenience store lot on Olive Drive about 20 minutes earlier, with two men in it.
A transformer caught fire on a pole on Quincy Street just west of Mount Vernon Avenue, and a second power pole was reported leaning in a driveway.

disposition: smoke detector and water flow in a building
summary: A commercial fire alarm at a cold storage plant on District Boulevard came from a smoke detector and a water flow alarm in one building.
A residential fire alarm brought an engine to Candlewood Drive and the call was cancelled.
A black Kia Optima was reported taken from a delivery driver on Wilson Avenue, and officers went after it westbound on Wilson Avenue with a white Honda Civic reported running with it.

disposition: occupants told to get out; building damaged
summary: Rain brought part of a roof down at an apartment on Actis Street and water was running inside the unit. Crews told the occupants to get out.
Person not breathing on I Street in Mojave.
Commercial fire alarm at South Valley Farms.
Vehicle and pedestrian collision at 24th and Oak.
Non-injury vehicle rollover near Airport Drive.
Pedestrians walking on highway shoulder.
Person receiving CPR after cardiac arrest at home.
Stabbing reported near K Street and Lake Queen.
Two-car crash on northbound Highway 99.
Person with butter knife at back house reported.
Commercial fire alarm near Pegasus Drive in Bakersfield.
Smoke in commercial building at Pegasus Drive.
Officer checks Range Rover on Interstate 5.
Single car crash off Highway 99 near Olive Drive.
Traffic stop for expired registration on Toyota.
Crash at North N Street and Panamint Street.
Single vehicle crash north of Keyesville Road.
Person injured near East 18th Street and Canyon Drive.
Vehicle registration check on Dodge van.
Single-car crash on northbound Highway 99.
